This free tool stops AI coding agents from breaking your codebase.

It’s called GitNexus.

Most AI coding tools don’t actually know your codebase structure, so they edit a function without realizing 47 other things depend on it, and something breaks.

→ Builds a knowledge graph of your repo: every dependency, call chain, and cluster mapped out

→ Works inside Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and more, so your agent gets full context in one query instead of guessing

→ Try the web version with zero install, or run one command locally: npx gitnexus analyze

One thing to know: it’s free for personal use, but commercial use needs a separate license, it’s not fully open source.
